problems.problem: Agent's summary states 'the claim is accurate in identifying Kuk Harrell as a producer' when the original claim explicitly says 'The writer of the song I Was Here is also a producer.' Since Diane Warren is the writer and not Kuk Harrell, the core premise of the claim is false. The summary should identify this as inaccurate rather than treating the claim as accurate regarding the producer identification.
